publication_layout: Place SOURCE-INDEX.md and SOURCE-INDEX.json beside source/ under Maintained Tools/AnonSSH in Sapient-Lumen/Lumen.

scope.purpose: Exact selected source locations, hashes and build modifications for the supplied portable binary.
limitations: Source URLs identify pinned build inputs; their accessibility is not proof of license compliance or distributor corresponding-source fulfillment.
The original sources.json describes the omitted supplied archive and is not a completeness claim for this publication.
Only bounded source URL probes and static source inspection were performed; remote full archives were not downloaded or hash-verified unless explicitly recorded.
libxcrypt, LDNS and Boost upstream sources were absent from the supplied source bundle although their symbols occur in embedded payloads; they are explicitly linked here.
The full transitive build-tool and runtime closure was not reconstructed. The pinned Nixpkgs tree contains additional recipes, build transformations and support inputs.

hash_semantics.raw_download_bytes: SHA-256 of the exact compressed upstream file (hex or equivalent SRI). Can be checked with sha256sum of the downloaded file.
hash_semantics.nix_recursive_unpacked_tree: SHA-256 of Nix recursive/NAR serialization of the unpacked source tree, with fetcher normalization. It is not the SHA-256 of the .tar.gz download. Use the pinned Nix fetcher to verify.
hash_semantics.nix_normalized_patch_bytes: SHA-256 of Nix fetchpatch normalized output, not the original HTTP patch response. Reproduce using the pinned fetchpatch recipe and its normalization attributes.
hash_semantics.raw_file_bytes: SHA-256 of the referenced file as bytes.
hash_semantics.nix_base32: A 52-character Nix-base32 SHA-256 is an encoding, not a different digest algorithm; the fetcher determines what is hashed.

project_source.implementation_note: The complete project ZIP preserves the implementation. The published README anonymizes one illustrative personal path. The repository source/ directory is only a browsing copy.
build_instructions: Extract the complete project ZIP and work in AnonSSH-0.2.0-9831b007cd47/.
project_source.modification_instructions: Use default.nix from the complete project ZIP for all AnonSSH overrides; the same build expression and patch are browsable under source/. For modified Dropbear, start from the pinned upstream source, apply Nixpkgs pass-path.patch, then nix/dropbear-runtime-helpers.patch. Retain the Nixpkgs configure/build logic rather than treating the patch alone as the full build recipe.
project_source.browsing_copy_note: The repository source/ directory is an 85-file code/docs/manifests browsing copy. It omits 636 RouterInfo bootstrap files and is not the complete build tree. Use the full project ZIP for builds.

complete_archive.local_comparison: All 721 paths match the supplied project tree. README.md is the sole byte-different file; all implementation, patches, manifests and bootstrap RouterInfos match.
complete_archive.remote_delivery_verification: Publisher must verify this release asset after upload; this source-index pass verified the local ZIP, not its future remote delivery.

sources.name: Tor
sources.role: Embedded Tor executable; six selected static libraries below.
sources.selection_notes: AnonSSH overrides the Nixpkgs Tor 0.4.9.13 source with 0.4.9.14, enables GPL code, disables systemd/seccomp/libcap, replaces buildInputs with six static libraries, sets -static -lgcc, clears postPatch, builds src/app/tor, disables checks. The Nixpkgs patches array is retained.

sources.availability_note: The dist, official archive and EFF mirror tarball probes returned Site Unavailable HTML in this environment despite HTTP 200/206. Public Tor download and archive pages list the exact release; this is not a claim that those URLs are globally unavailable. Supplied upstream tarball bytes were independently hashed and match the build recipe. No different version or Git checkout is substituted.

sources.name: OpenSSL
sources.role: Tor, i2pd and OpenSSH cryptographic static build input.
sources.selection_notes: pkgs/top-level/all-packages.nix selects openssl_3_5; static-musl modifications and local patches are in the pinned recipe.

sources.name: zlib
sources.role: Tor, i2pd, OpenSSH and Dropbear static build input.

sources.name: i2pd
sources.selection_notes: AnonSSH uses pkgsStatic.i2pd.override { upnpSupport = false; }; selected inputs are Boost, zlib and OpenSSL, not miniupnpc.

sources.name: OpenSSH Portable
sources.role: Embedded ssh, sftp-server and scp executables.
sources.selection_notes: First URL resolves the pinned mirror://openbsd entry; second is an official OpenBSD CDN alternative. pkgs.openssh is the plain OpenSSH variant, not HPN or GSSAPI. Its shared recipe is pkgs/tools/networking/openssh/common.nix; static selection disables PAM/FIDO/security-key and keeps LDNS.

sources.name: Dropbear
sources.role: Embedded Dropbear server with AnonSSH runtime-helper patch.
sources.selection_notes: Apply the pinned Nixpkgs pass-path.patch first, then source/nix/dropbear-runtime-helpers.patch via the override in source/default.nix. This is not an unmodified upstream Dropbear binary.

sources.name: Java I2P certificate source
sources.role: Source of embedded reseed certificates; no Java router executable is embedded.
sources.selection_notes: All URLs are the exact ordered alternatives in the pinned fetchzip recipe; hash is the unpacked normalized tree, not any compressed download. AnonSSH copies certificates/ from pkgs.buildPackages.i2p output. Static audit found 35 embedded certificate byte matches in supplied Java I2P source.

sources.name: LDNS

sources.name: Boost
sources.role: Selected i2pd static dependency; Boost symbols observed in the supplied i2pd payload.

sources.name: musl libc
sources.role: Selected Linux pkgsStatic C runtime source; included for build provenance, not an independently reconstructed toolchain inventory.
sources.selection_notes: pkgs/top-level/stage.nix creates pkgsStatic with musl on Linux. The recipe also fetches BSD-compatible headers and iconv sources and applies patches; consult the full pinned recipe.

sources.name: libedit
sources.role: Selected OpenSSH package build input; not asserted to be linked into each of its three embedded executables.
sources.selection_notes: The OpenSSH package builds more programs than AnonSSH embeds. libedit propagates ncurses. This index does not classify these as demonstrated dependencies of the shipped ssh/scp/sftp-server payloads.

rust.selection: default.nix sets cargoLock.lockFile = ./Cargo.lock. Exact versions, registry sources and checksums below are copied from that lockfile. Cargo --locked enforces the lockfile; fetching still needs registry access unless dependencies are vendored. Build from the complete project ZIP, not the reduced repository browsing copy.

vendor_audit.notes: Static audit of supplied omitted archive matched its 196 vendored package identities/checksums and vendored file checksums to Cargo.lock. This is not remote archive revalidation or proof that every lockfile package is linked in this target.

inline_build_modifications.notes: Source/version override, six static libraries, --enable-gpl --disable-systemd --disable-seccomp, -static -lgcc, selected build/install phases, postPatch removed, tests off.
Appends runtime-helper patch to the pinned Nixpkgs patches; static server uses zlib and libxcrypt.
UPnP disabled; certificates copied from buildPackages.i2p output.
Pinned postPatch modifies async_posix.h for musl and engine paths for static builds; configure uses no-shared/no-module/no-ct, plus other platform flags. Use complete recipe.
Pinned postPatch substitutes configure archiver fields and removes gzopen_w from win32/zlib.def; complete recipe retained upstream.
Pinned patchPhase removes command -p from Makefile.in, autotools/Makefile.am, libcperciva/cpusupport/Build/cpusupport.sh and configure; patches test shebangs.
Pinned postPatch changes install mode 4711 to 0711; static configuration, selected features and /etc/ssh override are in the common and top-level recipes.

url_verification.method: Read-only HTTP GET; compressed sources probed with Range plus a bounded read (64 bytes for crates, 512 for other archives). Recipes and patches read up to 256/512 KiB. Status and content signature recorded, not a full download checksum. Exact raw Nixpkgs text files compared where noted. No supplied program or build script executed.
